members.Gonzalez: Art Gonzalez (Commissioner; appointed 2025-02-04 to the vacant seat, Vice Mayor early 2025)

standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Only approved minutes are posted; the last is the 2026-09-22 budget hearing. The October 2026 regular meeting has no minutes yet and its agenda was not located on the site

Minutes give tallies ("VOTE 4-1 Amsler") rather than full roll calls. Rolls are filled in from the attendance list when the vote is unanimous of those present, or when the dissenter is named; otherwise roll is null and the tally is in the notes
Commission vacancy filled by appointment of Art Gonzalez at this meeting; Mayor Groth attended by Zoom and left at 6:22 pm, so later votes are 4-0 without him

Several awards approve "the top-ranked proposer" without naming it in the minutes (tree installation 2026-04-07, stormwater Phase II-A 2026-04-07, Log Cabin roof 2026-05-05, NE 6th Avenue medians 2026-07-09)

Excluded under the standard: FDOT, county, mutual aid and North Miami agreements, grants, PBA MOUs, manager and police chief employment agreements, board appointments, meeting procedure changes, budgets and millage
